email.body1:
Jeff, saw Neuron7 launch the Complete Service Intelligence Stack off the $44M Series B and 300 percent ARR growth.

Scaling pipeline that fast usually means more accounts in play than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Neuron7 off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jeff, quick follow-up for Neuron7.

With ARR up 300 percent, expectations on pipeline jump faster than headcount can. Most sales directors don't actually know how many meetings the team needs to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Neuron7 needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Jeff, last bit of proof for Neuron7.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Neuron7's reply rate likely compares to other Series-B AI startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jeff, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Growing ARR that fast is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a Series-B motion? I'll tailor it to Neuron7 either way.
